grid:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a replacement 3D menu icon for the waveform timing-grid page of Drumvault. The reference image is ONLY a material, color and lighting reference; REPLACE its four square pads completely.
Subject: a freestanding sculptural AUDIO WAVEFORM crossing three understated vertical beat-timing lines. The waveform is a single connected chunky blue metal silhouette with rounded irregular lobes extending above and below its horizontal center line, like a short percussive audio recording. It tapers to quiet ends, has one large transient near the left third and two smaller trailing lobes. Three slender muted blue-silver beat lines stand behind the waveform, visible only above and below it. It should immediately read as a waveform being aligned to beats. NO checker grid, NO cells, NO square pads, NO bar-chart or equalizer. Broad simple geometry appropriate to 32-40px menu display.
High fidelity dimensional 3D product rendering, satin ice-blue faces, deep cobalt sidewalls, smoothly rounded bevels, gentle broad studio highlights from upper-left. Match the reference family but with smoother materials: absolutely NO brushed grain, NO hairline specular rims, NO sparkling white dots, NO chromatic fringe, NO microtexture. Keep good tonal separation without clipped white highlights. Modest orthographic 3/4 depth. Center the entire icon, filling around 84% of a square canvas.
Genuinely transparent alpha background, transparent spaces between timing lines. NO enclosing square, tile, badge, backplate, floor or cast ground shadow. No text or watermark. Clean antialiased edges without white matte.
topbar: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied panoramic abstract image for subtle use behind a 56px dark application header. Preserve the overall dark charcoal background, horizontally flowing ribbon composition, restrained teal, lavender and champagne accents and generous dark negative space. Remove ALL fine etched contour lines, hairline filaments, moire-like striations, grain, dust, white pixel specks, sharpening halos and bright pinpoints. Replace those tiny lines with broad smooth satin ribbon surfaces and softly feathered tonal transitions. Keep the sculptural flowing form but simplify the texture so it remains smooth when heavily scaled down or cropped to a thin header. Smooth low-frequency shapes, restrained contrast, soft edge lighting, no harsh or white highlights. Pixel-clean gradients without noise or banding, no intricate detail, no grid, no lettering, no logos. Very wide panoramic composition. Finished dark subtle image, not a UI mockup.
